_comment: Signature test vectors for packages/tiktok-shop (docs/plans/tiktok-shop-integration.md T1). Every credential here is a dummy: the official ones are TikTok's published documentation examples, the own ones are made up. Never put a real app key, app secret or token in this file.

api_sign.source: TikTok Shop Partner docs (sign algorithm example), copied by the owner's assistant; verified with openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac on 27 Nov 2026

webhook.source: TikTok Shop Partner docs, Order Sync guide Appendix B (webhook signature example), body supplied by the owner on 27 Nov 2026; verified: printf '%s' 'abcdef' + body | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac '123' reproduces the published hex

api_sign.name: post_body
api_sign.description: POST whose JSON body has significant whitespace (spaces, a newline, a space before a comma); params unsorted
api_sign.derived_with: string_to_sign written as UTF-8 bytes to a file with no trailing newline, then: openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac 'dummysecret' -r < string-to-sign.txt (27 Nov 2026)

api_sign.name: unsorted_empty
api_sign.description: GET without a body; params arriving unsorted, an empty value (shop_cipher), a page_token holding + / =
api_sign.derived_with: string_to_sign written as UTF-8 bytes to a file with no trailing newline, then: openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac 'dummysecret' -r < string-to-sign.txt (27 Nov 2026)

api_sign.name: unicode_body
api_sign.description: POST whose body holds non-ASCII text (em dash, check mark, emoji, accented letter), signed as UTF-8
